text: おまえの　ポケモン　すこしは　つよく　なったかよ？

structure.jp: おまえの　ポケモン
つよく　なったかよ？

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A describing word with its last い changed to く plus なる means 'become that way'. つよく　なった = 'got stronger'.

patterns.name: 〜は (at least)
patterns.explanation: は after an amount gives the feeling of 'at least that much'. すこしは = 'at least a little'.

patterns.name: 〜かよ
patterns.explanation: かよ at the end is a rough, slightly mocking way for a boy to ask a question. なったかよ = 'well, did they get any?'
